meta.blank_policy: Unknown values are null and rendered as labelled blanks, never zero.

flags.title: Personal eligibility and tax facts are unknown
flags.detail: Balance, source of funds, residence history, household registration, prior US filings, account classification and treaty positions were not supplied. No personal tax, penalty or eligibility conclusion is populated.

flags.title: No executable FX quote
flags.detail: The BOC board is a reference snapshot with a publisher timestamp later than the report date and unestablished timezone. Actual online/branch transaction rates govern.

flags.title: Receiving-bank and intermediary charges are unknown
flags.detail: No user receiving-bank fee was supplied. BOC overseas charges are actual; SC OUR does not guarantee every beneficiary-side deduction. All receiving-fee cells remain blank.

flags.title: Wise limit conflict
flags.detail: Current help lists CNY 300,000 bank-app / CNY 50,000 Alipay per transfer; an older blog says CNY 100,000. The help centre is preferred, but product verification is required.

flags.title: Future BOC ATM tariff not applied
flags.detail: The announced Mastercard/VISA change takes effect 2026-11-11, after the report date. Current report-date tariff is used only as provider evidence; ATM total cost remains blank.

flags.title: SC tier and OUR limitations
flags.detail: Tier eligibility, FX execution and beneficiary-side deductions are unknown. A zero published sender component is not a zero all-in cost.

flags.title: Old emigrant staged-release schedule not confirmed current
flags.detail: Inherited editions present 50%/25%/25% staging. The 2014 circular allows lump sum or batches within approval; the full current operative section was not isolated. No staging schedule is populated.

flags.title: SAFE 2024 capital section 6.4 not independently isolated
flags.detail: The Ningxia PDF chunk retrieved did not contain section 6.4. The 2026 Tianjin FAQs and 2024 Beijing guide are used, with local-office confirmation required.

flags.title: Deposit-interest exemption scope
flags.detail: The retrieved notice temporarily exempts savings-deposit interest from 2008-10-09. It is not a blanket exemption for every investment, foreign account or US tax.

flags.title: Crypto authority updated
flags.detail: PBOC 2026 No.42 expressly repeals 2021 No.237. Older editions citing only No.237 are outdated as authority.

flags.title: IRS personal-FX passage is official-search-excerpt evidence
flags.detail: The USD 200 tip was verified in an official IRS search excerpt; repeated full-page chunks exposed navigation/other sections. No personal gain is calculated.

flags.title: Form 720 scope must not be overread
flags.detail: The 1% remittance excise concerns certain physical-instrument-funded transfers after 2025. Direction, provider and funding instrument must be established.

flags.title: Cash and carriage costs are not all-in
flags.detail: CNY 20,000 customs figure was not fully retrieved and is not numerically published. Travel, security, cash FX spread and destination rules remain unknown.

flags.title: Stock Connect current terms unverified
flags.detail: Only a historical 2014 operator presentation was retrieved. Current eligibility, quotas and fees are blank.

flags.title: Investment product fees and quotas unknown
flags.detail: WMC/QDII are regulated channels, not quoted products. Product fees, quota availability and redemption terms are blank.

flags.title: Corporate/unverified routes lack operative personal pricing
flags.detail: Real corporate transactions may be lawful, but no entity facts, approvals or prices were supplied. Unverified programmes have no populated limit or cost.

flags.title: Domestic vs overseas individual classification conflict
flags.detail: The convenience quota and Article 59 path depend on classification. Habitual residence, permanent-residence status and bank practice can change the result.

flags.title: Concurrent Edition D uses labelled assumptions and older tariff sources
flags.detail: Edition D is preserved, but its receiving-bank assumption, older BOC tariff and old crypto authority are adjudicated in Edition E’s audit. Edition E does not populate those assumptions as facts.
